description: This file defines a migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.9.0. It handles database schema updates, creates tables and columns related to themes and branding, and inserts configuration data like themes and menu items.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for managing database schema migration to version 4.9.0 in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the database schema updates, table creation, column additions, and insertions of configuration data for theme management.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the migration, which is '4.9'.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to insert new menu items into the admin menu, linking to specific screens.

methods.name: insertTheme
methods.description: Helper method to insert a theme with specified variables if it does not already exist.
